reviews.review:
Honestly I been wanting to try this one since it was announced at the game awards and ya know.....its ok.  Nothing great or deep or difficult.  Just mindless fun for kids basically.  For adults that play much deeper games like path of exile or last epoch or poe2 or torchlight infinite etc etc etc, its just so basic its tough to play and feel much from it.

I do recommend the game if you into very easy, kid friendly game.  But arpg enthusiasts will not enjoy the game as its a bit too basic.  Also the 50 dollar price tag is a tough one since the genre is very free to play friendly.  Its just not much for the pricetag.  Im sure the price tag is the licensing of the characters since I KNOW they aren't cheap.

Everything being voice acted is cool, I grew up with most of these characters and its weird to hear different voice actors for a lot of the cast, but thats normal for stuff like this im sure.  
Graphics are, meh, functional, good enough.
movement is ok, not smooth as you might expect, very easy to get stuff on random objects you may not notice.

All and all its decent but I would expect this to be a kids only game quite honestly.
